# PROCESS — cand_0007 (parent cand_0005, the current champion, val 0.604)

Method: 4 parallel read-only diagnosis subagents covering ALL 36 failing cand_0005 traces
(groups A/B/C/D of 9 each), then I read the two target traces (53023, 47699) directly to
confirm the mechanism against the actual code + printed output. The dominant conclusion from
the fan-out: the residual 36 are overwhelmingly INTERPRETATION-VARIANCE (task-specific
reading/tie-break/sign/grouping that no general prompt rule can pin down) or refuted levers.
The one genuinely NEW, bounded, verifiable signal is that **cand_0005's own accepted edit
("write a corrected FORMULA, never a hardcoded value") is the root cause of two current
failures (47699, 53023) that were PASSING under cand_0003** — LEDGER confirms
`cand_0005 broke {347-49, 47699, 53023}`. So this iteration is disciplined regression-recovery
by NARROWING that over-broad rule + filling one true knowledge gap (`_xlfn.` prefix), staying
strictly clear of cand_0006's toxic breadth.

## Ranked cluster list (leverage = # failing tasks × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Rewrote a `_xlfn.`-prefixed modern-function formula and dropped the prefix → `#NAME?`; also blocked from writing the scalar it had already computed by "never a hardcoded value" | 53023 (F11 input `=_xlfn.XLOOKUP(...)`; agent wrote bare `=XLOOKUP(...)`, had hand-computed `4`) | cand_0005's "always write a corrected FORMULA, never a literal" over-broad wording + missing `_xlfn.` knowledge | KNOWLEDGE + NARROWING |
| 2 | Aggregating (count/sum) over a column of FORMULA cells with the default loader reads formula TEXT, not values → under-count | 47699 (count FALSE over a VLOOKUP column; wrote 3, missed formula-produced FALSEs) | missing fact: default `load_workbook` returns formula strings; need `data_only=True` or a COUNTIF/SUMIF/COUNTA formula | KNOWLEDGE |

## Edits kept (all in prompt.md; each additive/narrowing; verify + blast-radius)
| # | cluster | edit | verify-the-fix | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 1 | In the "answer cells ALREADY contain formulas" bullet, changed "write a corrected/extended FORMULA, never a hardcoded value" → "…using standard, recalc-safe functions… EXCEPTION: if the corrected answer would need a modern/dynamic function that recalculates unreliably, write the single value you computed in Python instead." | 53023 trace: agent hand-computed `4` (`Hand-computed returned cost: 4`) but, following the "never a hardcoded value" clause, wrote a fragile `=XLOOKUP(...)`; the exception now routes a modern-function scalar to the computed literal. | BOUNDED (narrowing). Condition = "corrected formula would need a modern/dynamic function." Passing formula-writers (37962, 49237, 2212, 32255, 35747, 37086, 44264, 45581, 54675, 31420, 2768, 50682) write STANDARD functions (SUM/IF/VLOOKUP/SUMPRODUCT/SUMIFS) → condition false → unaffected. |
| 2 | 1 | Appended to the dynamic-array paragraph: openpyxl stores a formula string verbatim, so modern functions must keep the `_xlfn.` prefix (`=_xlfn.XLOOKUP(...)`, `=_xlfn.IFS(...)`, `=_xlfn.TEXTJOIN(...)`, `=_xlfn.XMATCH(...)`); a bare `=XLOOKUP(...)` → `#NAME?` = 0; preserve an existing `_xlfn.` prefix; for a single-cell result prefer the computed literal. Explicit note: "affects ONLY these modern/dynamic functions — standard SUM/IF/VLOOKUP/SUMIFS/INDEX-MATCH/COUNTIF/SUMPRODUCT still written as formulas." | 53023 input held `=_xlfn.XLOOKUP(B11,I4:I8,_xlfn.XLOOKUP(...))`; agent's saved `=XLOOKUP("*"&B11&"*"&C11&"*",...)` dropped the prefix. Keeping it (or writing the literal `4`) fixes it. | BOUNDED (additive knowledge). cand_0006's grep of all 55 passing traces found NO passing task writes `_xlfn`/XLOOKUP/XMATCH/TEXTJOIN, so no passer's behavior changes. Crucially, unlike cand_0006's Edit 1, this does NOT tell the agent to avoid SUMPRODUCT/MATCH/COUNTIFS/NUMBERVALUE — the explicit "standard functions still written as formulas" clause protects the SUMPRODUCT/LOOKUP passers cand_0006 broke (35747, 50682, 56561). |
| 3 | 2 | New WRITE-GENERAL-CODE bullet: aggregating over a column of FORMULA cells with the default loader returns formula TEXT not values → under-count; re-open `data_only=True` or write a `COUNTIF`/`SUMIF`/`COUNTA` formula. | 47699 trace: `workbook_summary` showed col A = VLOOKUP formula cells; agent looped `ws.cell(r,1).value` (default load) testing `is False`/`=="FALSE"`, so formula strings never matched → wrote 3 (under-count). Edit routes it to `data_only=True`/`COUNTIF`. | BOUNDED (additive knowledge). Fires only when aggregating over FORMULA cells; reading formula TEXT for an aggregate is always a bug, so no passing task relies on it. `data_only=True` on plain-value cells returns the same value; COUNTIF/SUMIF/COUNTA are standard recalc-safe formulas. This is cand_0006's Edit 3 re-introduced IN ISOLATION — its breaks {35747,41410,42930,50250,56561} are all standard-formula-writers hit by cand_0006's Edit 1 breadth (array/modern-function avoidance), not by this aggregation rule. |

## Refuted / deliberately NOT re-tried (prior RESULTS refuted these — never re-test)
- **Array-CSE / modern-function breadth as an "avoid these, write literals" list** — cand_0006 Edit 1
  (`MATCH(1,(a)*(b),0)`, `{...}` constants, `NUMBERVALUE`/`TEXTJOIN`/`_xlfn.*` rewrite-or-literal),
  REJECTED (val 0.604→0.560), broke {35747, 41410, 42930, 50250, 56561}. My edits deliberately do NOT
  create such a list and explicitly protect standard SUMPRODUCT/COUNTIFS/VLOOKUP formulas. Targets
  55258, 58890, 6698 (array-CSE) therefore left UNFIXED — no safe prose lever.
- **Live `=TODAY()` for date-relative tasks** — cand_0006 Edit 2; the batch was rejected and 32023 was
  NOT in its fixed set, so a TODAY() formula does not fix 32023. Left unfixed. 34-5 "current month" is
  the same indeterminate-frozen-date class (INFRA-leaning). Not re-tried.
- **"Prefer literals over formulas" globally** — cand_0001 refuted. My Edit 1 is a narrow exception for
  modern/dynamic-function scalars ONLY, not a global preference.
- **Independent/adversarial VERIFY rewrite of task_template step 3** — cand_0002 REJECTED. Not re-tried.
- **Global no-embellishment block; cand_0004's whole batch** — refuted / net-zero. Not re-tried.
- **50486 sheet-casing rule** — genuine CONTRADICTION with 10281 (instruction-casing); net-zero. Skipped.

## ENVIRONMENT / non-prose-fixable — flagged, NOT edited
- **34-5**: "earlier than the current month" against a frozen past-dated GT — the reference month is
  indeterminate (neither the 2026 sandbox clock nor a data heuristic reproduces it). Documented by
  prior iterations as infra/temporal-indeterminate.
- **53062**: enormous sheet (48,610 rows × 133 cols) with nested COUNTIFS chains; the agent's fix is
  correct but a full LibreOffice recalc at that scale is the plausible blanket-0 cause. Prior iteration
  already handed it back as INFRA. No prompt edit applies.
- **55912**: invalid XML the agent worked around; the scored miss is a private "YES/YES+1" labeling
  convention (INTERPRETATION-VARIANCE, not fixable).

## Deliberately skipped (no safe/verified general fix — INTERPRETATION-VARIANCE)
10281, 14207, 146-49, 157-4, 250-20, 267-18, 269-44, 30930, 32468, 32975, 347-49, 398-14, 39946,
413-15, 45944, 48983, 49782, 50526, 50755, 53305, 53449, 55039, 577-40, 58484, 585-41. Each requires a
task-specific reading (grouping key, tie-break, boundary inclusivity, sign, sentinel-as-zero, transpose
layout, per-row ad-hoc method) that no general rule reproduces; several already pass 2/3 and fail only a
data-shape edge the visible sample doesn't exercise. **4225** (whole-word keyword match + precedence) was
considered but DROPPED: the agent already reproduces the instruction's worked example yet scores 0/3, so
a whole-word rule is not verified to fix it (fails the VERIFIED test) — and 4225 was previously flagged
as "correct output scored 0/3" (INFRA-leaning). **50755** cannot be reached by the preserve-formula edit:
at grading time its answer cells are blank and the gold contradicts the stated arithmetic.

## Process & features used
- 4 parallel read-only diagnosis subagents (general-purpose) over all 36 failing traces; I then read
  53023 + 47699 myself to confirm the exact code/mechanism. All three edits are in prompt.md
  (task_template.md left unchanged — these are contract/knowledge fixes belonging in the system prompt).
  Applied serially in this one candidate (no worktree merge needed). Placeholders in task_template.md
  untouched and intact.
